gaps.concept: BPH histology shows papillary gland infoldings and often corpora amylacea within enlarged glands.
gaps.why_tested: A prostate specimen shows benign glandular proliferation with laminated luminal concretions.

gaps.concept: Five-alpha-reductase inhibitors can cause decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, and gynecomastia.
gaps.why_tested: A patient develops sexual adverse effects after starting finasteride for urinary symptoms.

gaps.concept: Alpha-1A blockade can impair ejaculation.
gaps.why_tested: A patient develops abnormal ejaculation after starting tamsulosin.

gaps.concept: PSA rises with BPH and prostatitis as well as cancer; an elevated value is not cancer-specific.
gaps.why_tested: A patient with a tender prostate or benign enlargement has an elevated PSA.

gaps.concept: The free-to-total PSA ratio tends to be lower in prostate cancer than in BPH.
gaps.why_tested: Two patients have similar total PSA values, and the question asks which is more likely to have cancer.

gaps.concept: Prostate cancer may feel hard and irregular on digital rectal examination; BPH typically causes smooth, symmetric enlargement.
gaps.why_tested: An examination finding must distinguish malignancy from benign enlargement.

gaps.concept: High-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia is a carcinoma precursor with atypical luminal cells but retained basal cells.
gaps.why_tested: A biopsy shows atypical glands with an intact basal-cell layer.

gaps.concept: TMPRSS2–ERG fusion drives androgen-regulated ERG expression in many prostate cancers; PTEN loss can cooperate in progression.
gaps.why_tested: A prostate tumor is described by its characteristic gene fusion or cooperating tumor-suppressor loss.

gaps.concept: Prostate adenocarcinoma arises from secretory luminal epithelium; PSA, prostatic acid phosphatase, and NKX3.1 support prostatic origin in metastases.
gaps.why_tested: Immunostains are used to identify the source of an adenocarcinoma in bone or a lymph node.

gaps.concept: Continuous GnRH agonist exposure downregulates pituitary GnRH receptors, lowering LH, FSH, and testosterone after the initial flare.
gaps.why_tested: Hormone levels are measured after sustained leuprolide treatment.

gaps.concept: Androgen deprivation can cause hot flashes, reduced libido, gynecomastia, and bone loss.
gaps.why_tested: A patient develops characteristic adverse effects during prostate cancer hormone therapy.

gaps.concept: Abiraterone can cause mineralocorticoid excess with hypertension, hypokalemia, and fluid retention.
gaps.why_tested: A patient develops a characteristic blood-pressure and electrolyte pattern after CYP17 inhibition.

gaps.concept: Chronic pelvic pain syndrome causes persistent pelvic or perineal pain without a reproducibly positive bacterial culture.
gaps.why_tested: Recurrent pelvic pain must be distinguished from chronic bacterial prostatitis.

gaps.concept: Hypospadias is a ventral urethral opening caused by incomplete urethral-fold fusion, often with ventral curvature.
gaps.why_tested: A newborn has a ventral meatus and a downward-curved penis.

gaps.concept: Epispadias is a dorsal urethral opening associated with the bladder-exstrophy spectrum.
gaps.why_tested: A newborn has a dorsal urethral defect and an exposed bladder.

gaps.concept: Condyloma acuminata are exophytic genital warts caused mainly by HPV 6 and 11; histology shows koilocytes.
gaps.why_tested: A penile wart is paired with its viral type or microscopic appearance.

gaps.concept: High-risk HPV E6 degrades p53 and E7 inactivates RB, promoting penile squamous neoplasia.
gaps.why_tested: A question asks how HPV-associated penile carcinoma disrupts cell-cycle control.

gaps.concept: Erythroplasia of Queyrat forms a velvety red glans plaque; Bowen disease a shaft plaque; bowenoid papulosis multiple papules.
gaps.why_tested: The appearance and location of an in-situ penile squamous lesion must be identified.

gaps.concept: Invasive penile squamous carcinoma breaches the basement membrane and may show keratin pearls.
gaps.why_tested: A penile biopsy must distinguish carcinoma in situ from invasive disease.

gaps.concept: Penile squamous carcinoma often presents as a persistent painless ulcer or exophytic mass and spreads to inguinal lymph nodes.
gaps.why_tested: A nonhealing penile lesion is accompanied by enlarged groin nodes.

gaps.concept: An HPV-independent pathway to penile squamous carcinoma is associated with lichen sclerosus and chronic inflammation.
gaps.why_tested: A carcinoma develops beside longstanding sclerotic penile lesions without evidence of high-risk HPV.

gaps.concept: Candida commonly causes balanitis, particularly in uncircumcised patients or those with diabetes.
gaps.why_tested: A patient with diabetes develops an inflamed, itchy glans and foreskin.

gaps.concept: Genital herpes typically causes grouped painful vesicles that ulcerate; primary syphilis causes a painless, indurated chancre.
gaps.why_tested: The morphology and pain of a penile lesion distinguish two common infections.

gaps.concept: Chancroid causes a painful, soft-edged genital ulcer with tender suppurative inguinal lymphadenopathy.
gaps.why_tested: A painful penile ulcer with a fluctuant groin node must be distinguished from syphilis.

gaps.concept: Gonococcal urethritis classically produces purulent discharge; chlamydial urethritis often causes less conspicuous discharge.
gaps.why_tested: Penile discharge and dysuria are used to distinguish likely infectious causes.

gaps.concept: Parasympathetic S2–S4 activity mediates erection; sympathetic T11–L2 activity mediates emission and ejaculation.
gaps.why_tested: A spinal or pelvic nerve lesion is linked to impaired erection or ejaculation.

gaps.concept: Nitric oxide raises cavernosal cGMP to relax smooth muscle; PDE5 inhibitors prolong this signal during sexual stimulation.
gaps.why_tested: A question asks for the physiologic mechanism of sildenafil or tadalafil.

gaps.concept: PDE5 inhibitors are contraindicated with nitrates because combined cGMP signaling can cause severe hypotension.
gaps.why_tested: A patient taking nitroglycerin requests sildenafil.

gaps.concept: Sildenafil can cause headache, flushing, and blue-tinged vision from PDE6 inhibition.
gaps.why_tested: Visual color changes follow treatment for erectile dysfunction.

gaps.concept: Preserved nocturnal or morning erections favor psychogenic over vascular or neurologic erectile dysfunction.
gaps.why_tested: A patient reports situational erectile difficulty but retains spontaneous erections.

gaps.concept: SSRIs delay ejaculation and can be used for premature ejaculation; sexual dysfunction is also a common adverse effect.
gaps.why_tested: A question asks why an SSRI helps premature ejaculation or causes sexual symptoms.

gaps.concept: Ischemic priapism is painful, rigid, and low-flow; nonischemic priapism often follows trauma and is less painful.
gaps.why_tested: An erection after perineal trauma must be distinguished from a painful low-flow episode.

gaps.concept: Penile fracture classically causes an audible pop, immediate detumescence, swelling, and deformity; blood at the meatus suggests urethral injury.
gaps.why_tested: A sudden injury during intercourse is identified from its characteristic sequence of findings.

gaps.concept: Peyronie disease is associated with Dupuytren contracture, another fibrotic disorder.
gaps.why_tested: A patient with penile curvature also has palmar fibrous contractures.
